mathematical_scope.accepted: Every component contained in the decomposable locus has codimension g; nonconical cubic implies transversality; the specified three-odd-factor characteristic has pure local codimension g at diagonal points where all gamma_j-3*beta_j^2 are nonzero.
mathematical_scope.boundary: Inductive codimension and actual rank-one boundary access are both required; Cartier calculation is on a fine level cover, then finite descent. Boundary access is not proved for arbitrary components.
mathematical_scope.critique: The 2023 finite-jet algebraic-independence criterion is not used; its defect is not a refutation of the theta theorem or local dimension conclusion.
mathematical_scope.local_scope: The convergent weighted-graph, implicit-function and maximum-norm argument holds for each fixed g>=3. Finite checks g=3..8 do not imply all-genus validity.
mathematical_scope.rank: The equation Jacobian at the specified diagonal points has rank exactly 3; for g>3 the dimension conclusion gives no smoothness or reducedness of the entire gradient scheme.
mathematical_scope.target: Reduced support in interior complex ppav moduli, including decomposables: every nonempty component of the odd two-torsion multiplicity-at-least-three locus should have codimension g. Empty g=1,2 cases are vacuous.
mathematical_scope.unresolved: Global component accessibility, arbitrary genus, higher-order/conical cubic possibilities remain open in this program. No full resolution or novelty claim.
